name: labs/instrumentkit__instrumentkit
title: Tektronix DPO70000 oscilloscope (instrumentkit)
intro: Tektronix DPO70000 oscilloscope (instrumentkit), adapted from instrumentkit/instrumentkit. It reads `acquire_enhanced_enob`, `acquire_enhanced_state`, `acquire_interp_8bit`, `acquire_magnivu` and 8 more; runs `run_acquisition`, `stop_acquisition`, `force_trigger`, `software_trigger` and 1 more. `run_acquisition`: enable the trigger and start acquisition (the native run, :RUN). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
